missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Чемодан' is masculine nominative as the subject of 'стоит'. 'Мой' agrees in the masculine, and 'у двери' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Чемодан' is the accusative direct object of 'собрал'; inanimate masculine nouns keep the nominative form. 'Уже' marks completion.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В чемодане' uses the prepositional ending after 'в' to locate the contents. 'Тёплая одежда' is the nominative subject inside the suitcase.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Чемодана' is genitive after 'нет', and 'большого' agrees in the masculine genitive. The frame 'у меня нет' expresses lacking something.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Из чемодана' takes the genitive after 'из' to show motion out of the suitcase. 'Документы' is the accusative object of 'достал'.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'В чемодан' uses the accusative after 'в' to show motion into the suitcase. 'Подарок' is the accusative object of 'положил'.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Чемодану' is the dative form marking what receives the sticker. 'Новую наклейку' is the accusative object of 'дал'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'С чемоданом' uses the instrumental after 'с' to mean accompanied by the suitcase. 'Тяжёлым' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Чемоданы' is the nominative plural subject of 'стоят'. 'Все' quantifies them, and 'в коридоре' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Чемоданов' is the genitive plural required after 'сколько'. The verb 'берёшь' asks how many suitcases you are taking.
